C1335.title: ClickFix-Based Booking.com Phishing Campaign Targets Global Hospitality Professionals
C1335.summary: In November 2025, a phishing campaign leveraging the ClickFix technique targeted hospitality professionals worldwide by sending spoofed emails impersonating Booking.com. The emails used an interactive ClickFix lure to trick recipients into copying and executing malicious commands, bypassing traditional email security detection.
